info.desc: Electric Warrior is the sixth studio album by British rock band T. Rex (being the second album under the name "T. Rex", with the first four billed as "Tyrannosaurus Rex"). The album marks a big turning point in the band's sound as it dispenses with the folk-oriented music of the previous albums and takes on a new music genre, glam rock. The album also drew attention to the band in the USA with the massive hit "Get It On". Though the album is full of rock classics, several of the songs still display something of the lyrical poetics of the .

podcast.body: Released in September 1971, this album elevated the sound and attitude established by "Ride a White Swan." It was characterized as fun, funny, cartoony, fantastical, and provocatively naughty, making it a significant album that rocked with a distinct glam rock style and sound, and is considered the first glam rock album. "Electric Warrior, I think we can say, was the first glam rock album."

podcast.title: Glam Rock Landmark
podcast.body: This album is considered a complete glam music album and is frequently cited as officially inaugurating the "golden age" of glam, preceding David Bowie's *Ziggy Stardust* which it heavily inspired. It fully embraced glam clichés, including Marc Bolan's iconic persona, vibrant clothing, irreverent behavior, and provocative lyrics. The album features characteristic glam ballads and retains psychedelic guitar influences. Its biggest hit, "Get It On," is on this record. It marked a significant turning point in UK music, bridging the 60s and 70s sounds. "en 1971, saca una auténtica obra maestra que sería el electric warrior. Sí que el electric warrior ya son disco completamente de música glam."
